places.connection: The original gallery where Monet first exhibited twenty of his Cathedral paintings in May 1895.

places.connection: Holds the largest collection of paintings from the Rouen Cathedral series.

places.connection: Location of 'The Portal of Rouen Cathedral in Morning Light, 1894'.

places.connection: The subject of the painting series.

places.name: Bureau des Finances (painting location)
places.connection: Monet rented rooms in this building, directly opposite the cathedral, to paint the series.

places.name: National Museum of Serbia
places.connection: Current location of this specific painting.

places.name: Monet's First Painting Location (M. Louvet's Shop)
places.connection: Monet rented a room here in February 1892 for his first campaign. The building now houses the Rouen tourist office.

places.name: Monet's Second Painting Location (Fernand Levy's Shop)
places.connection: Monet worked from a second-floor room here during his 1892 and 1893 campaigns, offering a different angle on the facade.

places.name: Monet's Studio in Giverny
places.connection: Monet completed and harmonized the Cathedral series in his Giverny studio between 1894 and 1895, working from the canvases he had begun in Rouen.
